text:
KYC Document Review Assistant
Region: UK
Segment: retail_bank
Regulator: FCA
Problem solved: Automate first-level review of customer KYC documents and identify missing or inconsistent information.
Capabilities: Document classification; Identity information extraction; Missing document detection; KYC exception flagging
Integrations: Document Management System; Customer Master; KYC Case Management
Outcome: Reduced manual KYC review effort and improved identification of incomplete onboarding cases.

Loan Underwriting Decision Assistant
Region: UK
Segment: lender
Regulator: FCA
Problem solved: Assist underwriters by extracting borrower information and producing a structured underwriting summary.
Capabilities: Application data extraction; Financial document analysis; Risk factor identification; Underwriting summary generation
Integrations: Loan Origination System; Credit Bureau; Document Repository
Outcome: Faster preparation of underwriting cases with consistent summaries for human review.

Insurance Claims Triage Copilot
Region: UK
Segment: insurer
Regulator: FCA
Problem solved: Prioritize incoming insurance claims and route complex cases to the appropriate claims team.
Capabilities: Claims classification; Severity assessment; Policy information extraction; Claims routing
Integrations: Claims Management System; Policy Administration System; Customer CRM
Outcome: Improved claims triage speed and reduced manual routing effort.

Regulatory Reporting Preparation Assistant
Region: UK
Segment: capital_markets
Regulator: FCA
Problem solved: Assist operations teams in preparing regulatory reporting submissions by consolidating information from multiple systems.
Capabilities: Data extraction; Reporting field mapping; Validation checks; Exception identification
Integrations: Data Warehouse; Trade Management System; Regulatory Reporting Platform
Outcome: Reduced manual preparation effort and improved consistency of regulatory reporting workflows.

Fraud Alert Triage Assistant
Region: India
Segment: retail_bank

Bank Customer Service Copilot
Region: India

SME Loan Underwriting Copilot
Region: India
Segment: lender
